### BlueLinx to Host Third Quarter 2026 Results Conference Call and Webcast on November 4, 2026


October 21, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s25.q4cdn.com/432003941/files/doc_news/BlueLinx-to-Host-Third-Quarter-2026-Results-Conference-Call-and-Webcast-on-November-4-2026-2026.pdf)


ATLANTA--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


BlueLinx Holdings Inc. (NYSE: BXC), a leading U.S. wholesale distributor of building products, will issue third quarter 2026 financial results after the market closes on Tuesday, November 3, 2026. A conference call to discuss the Company’s results will be hosted by Shyam Reddy, President and Chief Executive Officer, and Kelly Wall, Senior Vice President, Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer, on Wednesday, November 4, 2026, at 10:00 AM ET.


A webcast of the conference call and accompanying presentation materials will be available in the Investor Relations section of the BlueLinx website at[https://investors.bluelinxco.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.bluelinxco.com%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54625598&newsitemid=20261021556005&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.bluelinxco.com&index=1&md5=42fe71763c185050e94f43063817ff44) , and a replay of the webcast will be available shortly after the webcast is complete.


To participate in the live teleconference:


North America (Toll-Free):


1-833-461-5787


International (Toll):


1-585-542-9983


Passcode:


692 121 823


**ABOUT BLUELINX**


BlueLinx Holdings Inc. (NYSE: BXC) is a leading U.S. wholesale distributor of residential and commercial building products with both branded and private-label SKUs across product categories such as lumber, panels, engineered wood, siding, millwork, and industrial products. With a strong market position, broad geographic coverage footprint servicing 50 states, and the strength of a locally focused sales force, we distribute a comprehensive range of products to our customers which include national home centers, pro dealers, cooperatives, specialty distributors, regional and local dealers and industrial manufacturers. BlueLinx provides a wide range of value-added services and solutions to our customers and suppliers, and we operate our business through a broad network of distribution centers. To learn more about BlueLinx, please visit[www.bluelinxco.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.bluelinxco.com&esheet=54625598&newsitemid=20261021556005&lan=en-US&anchor=www.bluelinxco.com&index=2&md5=a608131901d176f193f4c4b95bafc170)
